diagnostics.message: :resource.null_resource.wait_for_cluster: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_eks_cluster.this is redundant — already implied by attribute references

The explicit dependency from :resource.null_resource.wait_for_cluster to :resource.aws_eks_cluster.this duplicates the implicit dependency established by referencing the cluster endpoint in the provisioner environment.

The explicit dependency from :resource.null_resource.wait_for_cluster to :resource.aws_eks_cluster.this duplicates the implicit dependency created by referencing the cluster endpoint in the local-exec environment.

The managed node group resource :module.node_groups:resource.aws_eks_node_group.workers should wait for :resource.aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.workers_AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy. The node group's role ARN reference orders role creation, not this policy attachment; the AWS provider documentation specifically recommends ordering node groups after the worker policy attachment.

The managed node group resource :module.node_groups:resource.aws_eks_node_group.workers should wait for :resource.aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.workers_AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy. Its IAM role reference does not order this attachment, which is needed for workers' networking permissions.

The managed node group resource :module.node_groups:resource.aws_eks_node_group.workers should wait for :resource.aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.workers_AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly so the node role's image-pull permissions are attached before the node group is handled.

The managed node group resource :module.node_groups:resource.aws_eks_node_group.workers should wait for :resource.kubernetes_config_map.aws_auth. The source explicitly uses the aws-auth ConfigMap as a readiness gate before unlocking node-group creation, but the supplied graph does not express that dependency.

The self-managed worker Auto Scaling group :resource.aws_autoscaling_group.workers can launch instances as soon as its launch configuration is available, but its role-policy attachments are not dependencies. It should wait for :resource.aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.workers_AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy so nodes do not start before their worker permissions are attached.

The self-managed worker Auto Scaling group :resource.aws_autoscaling_group.workers can launch instances before the CNI permissions are attached. It should wait for :resource.aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.workers_AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy.

The self-managed worker Auto Scaling group :resource.aws_autoscaling_group.workers can launch instances before the image-pull permissions are attached. It should wait for :resource.aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.workers_AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly.

The launch-template worker Auto Scaling group :resource.aws_autoscaling_group.workers_launch_template can launch instances before the worker permissions are attached. It should wait for :resource.aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.workers_AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy.

The launch-template worker Auto Scaling group :resource.aws_autoscaling_group.workers_launch_template can launch instances before the CNI permissions are attached. It should wait for :resource.aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.workers_AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy.

The launch-template worker Auto Scaling group :resource.aws_autoscaling_group.workers_launch_template can launch instances before the image-pull permissions are attached. It should wait for :resource.aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.workers_AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly.
